name: reset-password
title: Reset password
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Choose a new password with strength and a match. An invalid or expired link asks for another.

files.content:
/**
 * Clean-room copy for password recovery and email verification.
 * One sentence per outcome. Nothing here takes an "account exists" flag.
 */

export type AuthLocale = "es-MX" | "en"

const LEAK =
  /no account|not found|does not exist|doesn't exist|no existe|sin cuenta|no encontramos|unknown user|user not found|correo no registrado|email not registered/i

export function recoveryCopyLeaksAccount(text: string) {
  return LEAK.test(text)
}

docs: Clean-room. shadcn/studio reset-password (Free and Pro) was not copied: the Free tier adds the Commons Clause, which blocks redistribution in a component library, and Pro was not purchased. No source, sample data, icons, or strings were copied. The card reuses password-field and password-strength. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion. Host errors are not rendered, so a rejection cannot reveal an account (proposed hub rule RUI-AUTH-ENUM-001).
